title: Mapping the Knowledge Structure of Baseball Psychology Research: code and data for a systematic mapping review
description: Analysis code, retrieved bibliographic records, screened corpus with topic and domain assignments, relevance lexicons, PubMed metadata enrichment, sensitivity analyses, and figures for a systematic mapping review of baseball psychology research (Lee and Han, Frontiers in Psychology). Code is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE); derived data and figures under CC BY 4.0.
